request.query: cart-service is returning 5xx errors after a deploy

report.summary: cart-service 5xx errors after deploy due to a NullPointerException in PromotionEngine.applyDiscount

likely_causes.title: NullPointerException in PromotionEngine.applyDiscount causing 5xx responses
likely_causes.rationale: The logs contain repeated NullPointerException stack traces at PromotionEngine.applyDiscount, and the metrics show a sudden 15.00pp spike in 5xx error rate, indicating that this exception is directly causing the failures.

likely_causes.title: Deployment introduced code change that triggers NPE due to missing promotion data
likely_causes.rationale: The absence of any deploy-related logs combined with the NPE suggests that a recent code change may have removed or altered the handling of promotion data, leading to null values.

likely_causes.title: Missing environment variable leading to null promotion context
likely_causes.rationale: A missing environment variable could cause the promotion context to be null, which would trigger the observed NPE.

next_steps: Rollback to the last known good deployment
Investigate PromotionEngine.applyDiscount for null handling and add defensive checks
Add unit tests to cover promotion data scenarios
Verify that all required environment variables are set and documented
Monitor 5xx error rate and logs after changes to confirm resolution
